title: Senior Software Engineer, Hyperscale Build Infrastructure
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The Hyperscale Line of Business builds and ships products to hyperscale customers at exabyte scale, with an emphasis on speed, reliability, and operational excellence. The Build Environments and Tools team owns developer productivity infrastructure related to build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments that engineers rely on daily to build and test software.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join this team and help build fast, reliable, and reproducible build infrastructure at scale. You'll work hands-on with build orchestration, build-system internals, and containerized build environments - including large-scale C/C++ builds - while partnering with tech leads and engineers across the Hyperscale org to remove friction from everyday developer workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, develop, and maintain build orchestration systems and tooling

• Drive improvements to build speed, reliability, reproducibility, debuggability, and ease of use across local development and CI workflows

• Own and evolve containerized build environments, ensuring consistent, isolated, and reproducible build images

• Work on large-scale C/C++ build challenges, including dependency pruning, and static/dynamic linking tradeoffs

• Diagnose and resolve build-graph correctness issues, flaky builds, and incremental-build regressions

• Partner with tech leads and the engineering manager to shape the team's technical roadmap for build systems and developer tooling

• Collaborate with teams across the Hyperscale Line of Business and broader engineering to understand pain points, prioritize fixes, and align tooling investments with product delivery needs

• Establish and uphold operational excellence practices for build infrastructure: observability, incident response, change management, and continuous improvement

• Use engineering metrics to track and improve build performance, reliability, and developer experience

• Mentor other engineers on the team and contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and high technical standards

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including experience in infrastructure, developer productivity, build systems, or platform engineering

• Strong understanding of modern build systems and toolchains - dependency management, build-graph correctness, incremental and reproducible builds, artifact generation, and build isolation

• Hands-on experience with build systems and toolchains such as Make, CMake, Buck/Bazel or custom/in-house build orchestration tools

• Experience with large-scale C/C++ builds, including dependency pruning, static/dynamic linking tradeoffs, and reproducible containerized builds

• Hands-on familiarity with Linux-based development environments, Docker, and the operational concerns of maintaining consistent build images and execution environments

• Experience with CI pipelines and integrating build tooling into continuous integration workflows

• Experience using engineering metrics to evaluate and improve build performance, reliability, and developer experience

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with adjacent platform t

title: (Senior) Director UX, Operations
description:
About the role

HelloFresh is reorganising UX to work AI-native - practitioners either go deep as platform and skills experts, or broad as generalists who move fluidly across product, design and engineering to drive experience quality and innovation. This role leads UX for our Operations organisation: the part of the business that bridges technology with physical fulfilment, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain, across every market and brand we operate in.

You'll take over from a Director who spent two years shifting this function from reactive delivery to a high-leverage, AI-native strategic partner - including building an internal design platform, integrated with AI tooling, that other parts of the business have since adopted. You inherit that trajectory, not a finished product: some of our highest-stakes bets for 2026, including how we plan menus algorithmically at scale and how we run the internal tools that power supply-chain decision-making, are still being actively designed, not maintained.

This is a Berlin-based, in-person leadership role. Operations is one of several major, Berlin-anchored parts of our technology organization, and regular physical presence - with peers, with your team, and in the room for cross-functional decisions - is a deliberate requirement of how we want this function led going forward.

What you'll own

• UX strategy and quality across four core areas of Operations: menu planning and food systems (algorithmic menu planning, ranking, demand forecasting, assortment), fulfillment (production, order management, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, supplier reliability), an internal operations-research platform that runs dozens of optimization models across the supply chain, and the technology backbone that keeps our warehouses and production sites running.

description:
GEO Specialist
The GEO Specialist supports the strategy and execution of Generative Engine Optimization programs for a portfolio of B2B clients. This role works predominantly across on-site content planning and Reddit distribution (the two primary channels through which Foundation builds AI visibility) contributing to strategic engagements, content planning, and performance reporting.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
GEO Research & Execution

• Research and document the prompts, questions, and content gaps that matter most for each client's audience and competitive position.

• Support analysis using GEO tools such as Profound, Ahrefs, and more.

• Contribute to AI visibility benchmarking - tracking how clients are cited across LLMs and the AI Search space relative to competitors.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of GEO strategies, execution scopes, and client-facing reporting assets.

On-Site Content Planning & Support

• Create content plans which support AI citation

• Audit existing client content for GEO alignment and flag restructuring opportunities that could improve AI Visibility.

• Collaborate with writing and strategy teams to ensure content plans are executable and successful

Reddit Strategy

• Develop and manage Reddit strategies that build client visibility & presence in the community content sources AI models reference.

• Identify the right subreddits, content angles, and participation strategies for each client's audience and objectives.

• Plan platform-native content that earns upvotes & citation - understanding what Reddit culture demands vs. what traditional marketing assumes.

• Support the strategy which drives authentic Reddit presence including organic participation, strategic comment engagement, and branded posts where appropriate.

Performance & Reporting

• Track client KPIs including AI visibility, citation share, share of voice, AI referral traffic, prompt coverage, and Reddit engagement metrics.

• Contribute to regular performance reports with clear documentation of what's working, what isn't, and what to test next.

• Support ongoing testing across content formats, subreddit selection, post framing, and content structure.

Cross-Channel Integration

• Collaborate with creative, SEO, and senior GEO team members to ensure Reddit and on-site activity supports broader channel strategies.

• Surface audience insights - trending topics, community sentiment, competitive signals - and feed them into client content planning.

• Participate in client content audits and strategy sessions with a GEO and AI Visibility lens.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
Execution Quality

• Post-handoff survey: senior strategists and execution teams rate brief clarity and deliverable quality 1-5 (target ≥4).

• No more than 1 significant rework cycle per deliverable triggered by unclear or incomplete work.

Client Satisfaction

• Client NPS score within 4 weeks of initial strategy delivery (target ≥8).

• QBR question: "How confident are you in the strategic direction?" (1-5, target ≥4.5).

Growth Toward Strategist

• Demonstrated expansion of skills into adjacent areas (technical SEO, social strategy, earned media) via PDP milestones.

• Contribution of at least one reusable internal framework or playbook per quarter.

• Ability to contribute meaningfully to client strategy presentations within 6 months.

• Showcased presentation confidence & client facing, consultative ability.

- 3+ years of experience leading, managing or mentoring compliance professionals in a global or multi-regional setting.

title: Growth & Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT VERTO

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Growth and Marketing Manager to spearhead customer acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts across the UAE. In this pivotal role, you will build a strong local brand presence, launch high-impact campaigns, and drive measurable B2B growth. By identifying new market opportunities and leveraging your deep digital marketing expertise, you will play a central role in advancing Verto’s mission to become the leading cross-border payments partner in the region.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Drive B2B customer acquisition by developing pipeline strategies that yield high-intent, ICP-aligned prospects - focusing on deal quality, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity over raw lead volume.

- Optimise customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI through data-driven decision-making, continuous testing, and deep channel performance analysis.

- Partner closely with the Sales and Product team to design and execute highly effective Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns, continuously refine our ICP, and conduct win/loss analyses.

- Collaborate with the central global marketing team to activate paid media campaigns, ensuring local marketing activities are data-driven and commercially focused.

- Establish and aggressively scale Verto's local market presence in the UAE through strategic PR, thought leadership, local industry events, and brand partnerships.

- Develop compelling, region-specific content tailored to the UAE, including customer success stories, market trend reports, white papers, and sales enablement materials.

- Identify and cultivate strategic marketing partnerships with local industry associations, fintech partners, and relevant business organizations to expand Verto's reach.

- Work alongside the Retention Lead to launch initiatives that strengthen customer engagement, loyalty, and advocacy throughout the entire customer lifecycle.

- Track, analyze, and rigorously report on campaign performance, taking direct responsibility for significantly increasing the number of active UAE customers within your first 6-12 months.

WHAT YOU NEED

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of driving measurable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing strategies.

- Deep, practical understanding of the UAE market, encompassing both traditional and digital B2B marketing landscapes.

- Hands-on proficiency with modern marketing automation and product analytics tools such as HubSpot, PostHog, and major social media platforms.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About Onboarded
Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. In hiring, that's the work between the ATS and payroll: compliance, verifications, forms, approvals and handoffs. We're a Series A company with a small marketing team and a big opportunity ahead. We're early in building demand with technical buyers, and there's no established growth playbook to inherit.
 
That's where you come in.
The Role
We're looking for a hands-on B2B marketer who can build demand from the ground up.

Our primary audience is product and engineering leaders at HR technology and workforce software companies and at businesses building their own hiring products, with staffing firms and high-volume employers second.

You'll build and launch them yourself and use the results to decide what comes next. You'll use AI and automation extensively to move faster and make a small team more effective.

title: Stage - Ingénieur Structure Offshore - Optimisation Bearing Nodes pour les modul
description:
Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté.
Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.
Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.
Missions proposées :
Les unités flottantes offshore (FPSO, FLNG, etc…) sont constituées de plusieurs modules pesant plusieurs milliers de tonnes et supportés par la coque.
Chacun de ces modules repose sur la coque au travers de « bearing nodes », nœuds structuraux qui permettent de transmettre les efforts du module vers la coque tout en accommodant les mouvements relatifs entre ces deux structures.
Ces « bearing nodes » sont des structures complexes, comportant un nombre important de pièces et de soudures engendrant des temps significatifs d’analyses, de fabrication et d’inspection.
L’objectif du stage est d’étudier la faisabilité d’un concept de « bearing node » simplifié et standardisé couvrant plusieurs plages de chargement et pouvant être décliné sur de futurs projets.
L’étude portera sur :

• Analyse du design de référence

• Revue des concepts existants sur différents projets

• Identification des paramètres dimensionnants

• Analyse des difficultés de fabrication et de modélisation

• Développement d’un concept simplifié et standardisé

• Simplification de la géométrie

• Réduction du nombre de pièces et d’assemblages soudés

• Simplification des procédés de soudage

• Définition d’une gamme de variantes par plage de charges admissibles

• Evaluation des bénéfices

• Constructibilité et facilité de fabrication

• Performance

• Temps et complexité des calculs

• Impact poids

L'étude devra mettre en évidence les avantages, les limitations et le domaine d'application du concept proposé, ainsi que son potentiel de standardisation pour les futurs projets.
Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.

Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

• En cours de Bac +5 dans une école d'ingénieurs

• Vous suivez une formation en ingénierie des structures offshore ou navale

• Vous avez des connaissances en RDM et calculs de charpentes métalliques

• Vous avez des connaissances en Elément Finis

• Vous avez un anglais opérationnel (oral & écrit)

Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ?
Envoyez-nous votre candidature!

Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de projets novateurs et de collaborations actives. Entouré(e) de personnes diverses aux nombreux talents, vous vous sentirez accueilli(e), respecté(e) et impliqué(e). Vous évoluerez dans un environnement sûr et bienveillant où vous pourrez proposer de nouvelles idées, réinventer l'avenir et conduire le changement. • Experience profiling and optimizing distributed training at 1000+ GPU scale (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, FSDP)

• Background in ML infrastructure performance at a CSP/hyperscaler

• Familiarity with NVIDIA platforms (DGX, HGX, NVLink topology) and profiling tools

• Experience building automated performance regression detection systems for production environments

• Understanding of inference workload performance dynamics (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, continuous batching)

title: Strategy & Operations, Germany
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. Our EMEA organization translates OpenAI’s global mission and strategy into meaningful local impact, working across Growth, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance.

About the Role

As Strategy and Operations lead, you will develop country strategies, identify the most important market opportunities and barriers, align cross-functional teams around a focused set of priorities, and personally drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role. The primary focus is Consumer, with opportunities to create adjacent impact across B2B. You will go deep in a small number of priority markets while building approaches that can scale across EMEA.

This is not a strategy-only role. The successful candidate will combine rigorous analysis and market judgment with urgency, hands-on execution and the ability to influence without formal authority.

This role is based in Munich or Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Build country strategies: Develop plans, priorities and forecasts for key European markets and translate company strategy into practical local action.

- Drive growth and conversion: Use data, customer insight and experimentation to improve acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.

- Lead market expansion and localization: Identify opportunities, build scalable launch frameworks and determine where products and go-to-market should adapt.

- Turn strategy into execution: Personally move initiatives from diagnosis and prioritization through delivery, measurement and iteration.

- Lead cross-functional teams: Align Product, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance around shared outcomes.

- Represent regional insight: Ensure European market and customer perspectives shape global roadmaps and decisions.

- Measure and scale impact: Define success metrics and determine when a successful local approach should be replicated.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 10 years + of experience in growth, strategy, business operations or quantitative analytics with meaningful responsibility for outcomes.

- Have developed country, regional or multi-market strategies and translated them into focused execution plans.

- Bring exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, including forecasting, financial modeling and growth metrics.

- Can show examples of personally taking initiatives from insight through launch and measurement.

- Understand European markets while maintaining a regional and scalable perspective.

- Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and influence teams without formal authority.

- Operate with high ownership and urgency in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments.

- Have a deep interest in AI and alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/polici

title: Senior SAP Logistics Project Manager in Pharma
description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Logistics Project Manager to lead SAP logistics and supply chain transformation initiatives within a complex pharmaceutical environment. The role focuses on managing SAP implementation, integration, and optimisation projects across warehouse management, inventory management, procurement, and distribution processes.
You will be responsible for end-to-end project delivery, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders, and ensuring SAP logistics solutions align with business requirements, operational objectives, and pharmaceutical regulatory standards.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end SAP logistics projects, including implementation, migration, integration, and optimisation initiatives.

• Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful execution.

• Oversee SAP logistics workstreams involving SAP EWM, MM, WM, and related supply chain processes.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams, including SAP functional consultants, technical specialists, business stakeholders, and external vendors.

• Ensure alignment between SAP solutions and business requirements across warehouse management, procurement, inventory management, and distribution.

• Proven experience managing e nd-to-end SAP logistics implementations , rollouts, or transformation projects.

• Experience managing SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC projects.

• Solid understanding of warehouse management, inventory management, procurement, and distribution processes.

• Experience working within pharmaceutical or other regulated environments, with knowledge of GxP and GDP requirements.

• Strong project management capabilities, including budget management, resource planning, risk mitigation, and vendor coordination.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing senior business and IT stakeholders.

• Knowledge of project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid approaches.

• Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience with warehouse automation, supply chain integration, or distribution systems.

ITC was elected last year Gold Specialist Agency of the year for Greater China by the Prestigeous Magazine Campaign Asia and won several global awards.

Our expertise includes:

• Digital Transformation & Change Management (including Digital Transformation Talent Augmentation)

• CRM including Salesforce, sCRM, CDP, Data, Marketing Automation & Clienteling

• Tailor-made Digital & Commerce Experiences: WeChat Mini Programs, Websites, Apps, Magento, Drupal, WordPress, Laravel

About You
As a Project Director Assistant at ITC, you will step into the heart of project operations, supporting the Project Director in both strategic planning and daily team management. Project Management and Support:

title: Cloud Software Engineer – Managed Kubernetes
description:
The Container Services team is responsible for delivering Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes a platform that empowers customers to deploy, manage, and update their own Kubernetes clusters while simplifying the complexity that comes with running them at scale. We are looking for a motivated Cloud Software Engineer to help build and evolve this product.
You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of experienced professionals (software engineers, system engineers, scrum master, product owner and product management) that strive to make our product better.
Product Engineering at Leaseweb

Our team of approximately 145 engineers works in small scrum teams, each with end-to-end responsibility for a specific product or part of our architecture. We work on a remote-first basis, coming together in person at our Amsterdam headquarters twice a year.
Our organizational structure is flat, placing a high value on independence and entrepreneurship. The atmosphere is informal and relaxed, creating a highly motivating work environment where you will work alongside some of the most inspiring colleagues in the industry.
What is the role about?
In your role as a Cloud Software Engineer in the Container Services team, you are responsible for designing, developing and maintaining a platform that automates the delivery and management of Kubernetes Cluster for our customers. Your main activity will be working together with the team to design, implement and maintain the components that powers our product.
The components you will work on are responsible for deploying Virtual machines, configuring network, volumes, firewall rules, load-balancing and a lot of cloud-related concepts, making Kubernetes deployment work with Leaseweb Public Cloud.
In your journey, you may have to handle multiple parts of our tech stack: Kubernetes, Golang, Containers, ArgoCD, Helm charts.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop & maintain Kubernetes controllers & operators in Golang.

• Propose innovative solutions to meet the product's needs.

• Research, evaluate & recommend tools or components to improve our product, or satisfy a need.

• Collaborate with the Product Owner and the rest of the agile team to refine Product Backlog Increments & prioritize impactful features.

• Improve & maintain our platform, ensuring high-availability and scalability.

• Troubleshoot, Reproduce, Debug and resolve complex issues.

• Collaborate on open-source projects.

• Regular on-call duty (EOD-Engineer on Duty).

Who are you?
You have experience for developing Kubernetes operators in Golang. You are looking for new opportunities. You enjoy building new solutions using the latest technologies. You believe that continuous improvement also applies to yourself and have the desire to grow. You are not afraid to experiment but at the same time keep in mind observability, scalability, stability and reliability.
Your skill set:

• Have proven and demonstrable knowledge of programming languages, (e.g. Golang).

• Experience with developing & implementing Kubernetes components (e.g. Operators, Controllers, Custom Resource Definition CRD, Cluster API)

• Experience with creating container images with Docker files, Kubernetes Manifest and Helm charts.

• Experience with Kubernetes and related projects.

• Good knowledge of cloud related concepts, such as networking, storage, and virtualization.

• Able to collaborate with colleagues, perform code review.

• Able to work in a development team using common scrum practices.

• Good communication skills.

Nice to have

• Experience with Large Kubernetes deployments (measured by number of nodes) and the different tools available in the CNCF landscape.

• Experience with Continuous deployment (e.g. Jenkins, ArgoCD)

• Relevant experience with monitoring / observability tools (e.g. Icinga, Prometheus, Alert Manager, Loki, Grafana).

• Demonstrable knowledge of Linux and operating system internals.

title: Creative Designer | Logos
description:

We are Boosta , a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We’re currently looking for a Creative Designer to join Logos - a business developing an AI-powered self-discovery platform.
At the core of the product is AI as a personal companion that supports users on their journey of self-discovery. The product’s key value is helping people gain clarity about who they are, what they want, and why they make certain decisions. Its mission is to help people live happier lives by changing the way they understand themselves and perceive the world.
As a Creative Designer, you will:

• Develop promotional assets based on briefs, partnering with product teams to refine key messages, target audiences, core insights, and testing hypotheses.

• Collaborate with product designers to establish a unified visual and motion identity across marketing and the application that feels warm, calm, authentic, and dependable.

• Generate innovative ideas, visual strategies, and original concepts for both advertising campaigns and product design.

• Craft motion design elements alongside the design team, including onboarding sequences, App Store video previews, and micro-interactions.

• Analyze campaign performance metrics with product managers, extract actionable insights, and refine subsequent creative iterations.

• Contribute to building an internal system of reusable design templates, visual assets, and AI-driven workflows.

• Deliver top-tier work efficiently while consistently meeting project deadlines.

We’re looking for someone who:

title: Regional Finance Director (Practice Management)
description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve - we care.
What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
The US Oncology Network has an immediate need for a qualified candidate for the role of Regional Finance Director to join the Financial Operations team. This is a full-time position, reporting to the Sr. Regional Finance Director.

**REMOTE ROLE WITH TRAVEL**
Role Overview
This role serves as a key finance representative for a significant geographical region of The US Oncology Network, advising senior management and physician partners on the financial activities, issues, and operations of practices throughout the region. The Regional Finance Director combines a significant operational finance component with strategic analysis and effective reporting. This position partners with senior leadership to implement targeted growth strategies in support of achieving the long-range plan. The Director is responsible for the region’s FP&A and controller functions, including the management, preparation, and control of the unit’s budgets and forecasts with the aid of all regional financial operations staff.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Planning & Analysis

• Lead the monthly reporting/analytics function for regional leadership.

• Work closely with key business leaders to manage forecasting and budgeting processes.

• Partner with practices and management to execute initiatives that improve the financial performance of practices within the region.

Physician and Practice Engagement

• Regularly engage with Physicians and Practice Leadership to communicate financial results and provide strategic financial support.

• Actively participate in Practice Board meetings and collaborate with Physician, Practice, and Operations Leadership to prepare and present financial analysis and materials.

Key Performance Indicators

• Develop methodologies and approaches to ensure key internal performance indicators are incorporated and monitored as the lead for decision support tool development.

Capital Expenditures

• Support the capital expenditure process, including new project analysis and ongoing forecasting of regional capital spend.

Financial Management and Oversight

• Conduct timely, thorough analysis of practice financial results, focusing on indicators such as discounts, expense analysis/control, and related impact and receivables aging.

• Responsible for the approval of practice operating expense spend, financial statement account reconciliations, and internal controls.

Business Development

• Support specific development activities, including local/regional product line analysis, projections related to additional physician recruitment, and ongoing acquisitions.

Team Leadership

• Supervise and coach practice controllers and other financial operations staff, providing mentorship, guidance, and career development opportunities.

Other duties as assigned.
Minimum Requirement
Degree and typically requires 12+ years of professional experience and 4+ years of management experience.
Travel Requirements: 25% - 40% with approx~4-5 days of travel a month.

Critical Skills

• 12 years of experience in Financial Analysis, Valuations, Controllership, or similar roles.

• Must be able to successfully collaborate with key stakeholders across functional areas.

• Digital first mindset that will leverage AI to pursue process improvement

• Problem solver, persistent, and goal-oriented.

• Self-starting multi-tasker with strong organizational skills.

You’ll work in a CRM, 3CX call recordings, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams).

• Experience designing or delivering compliance training.

• Experience building or refining audit scorecards or compliance frameworks.

• Data and reporting skills, such as Excel pivot tables and dashboards.

title: AI/ML Researcher
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop - du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedin
